response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer with ~18 years of production software experience, current hands-on work with MCP servers and agentic-workflow tooling, and solid TypeScript/Node.js and cloud (AWS CDK) skills. However, his GenAI experience appears to span roughly one year, far short of the required 8+ years building AI-driven solutions, and there is no evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, evaluation pipelines, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI. He may be worth a conversation if the AI-experience bar is flexible, but he does not meet the role's core requirement as written.
strengths: Current hands-on experience with MCP code generators and agentic-workflow infrastructure, directly matching key technologies
Deep, broad production engineering background (TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, high-throughput systems) with staff-level titles
Demonstrated mentorship and knowledge-sharing (workshops, conference talks, courses), relevant to the mentoring and customer-facing aspects
concerns: Only ~1 year of GenAI/agentic work versus the required 8+ years of AI-driven solution development
No demonstrated experience with RAG, vector databases, LLM evaluation/observability, or multi-agent frameworks
Limited evidence of leading customer-facing technical discovery or forward-deployed/consulting engagements at enterprise scale
